summary: Suzano S.A., the Brazilian pulp and paper issuer listed on B3 (SUZB3) and NYSE (SUZ), filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Notice to the Market disclosing that BlackRock, Inc. crossed above 5% of its common shares. As of October 13, 2026, BlackRock held 62,366,570 common shares plus 876,317 ADRs (876,317 shares), totaling 63,242,887 shares, or approximately 5.003%, plus 16,963 cash-settled derivatives (~0.001%). BlackRock states the stake is strictly investment-related with no intent to alter control or management; no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for future stake changes under CVM Resolution 44.
